// Oracle: Trivy's ParseLDFlags (dependency/parser/golang/binary/parse.go,
// trivy 00b7394) with the real go-shellwords v1.0.16, pflag v1.0.10 and
// x/mod v0.42.0. Reads one ldflags string per line (Go-quoted), prints
// quoted input, version, and the -X map as JSON ("ERR" when parsing failed).
package main

import (
	"bufio"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"strconv"
	"strings"

	"github.com/mattn/go-shellwords"
	"github.com/spf13/pflag"
	"golang.org/x/mod/semver"
)

var defaultVersionPrefixes = map[string]bool{"main": true, "common": true, "version": true, "cmd": true}

func isVersionXKey(key string) bool {
	key = strings.ToLower(key)
	return strings.HasSuffix(key, ".version") || strings.HasSuffix(key, ".ver")
}
func isValidSemVer(ver string) bool { return semver.IsValid(ver) || semver.IsValid("v"+ver) }
func versionPrefix(s string) string {
	if i := strings.LastIndex(s, "/"); i >= 0 {
		s = s[i+1:]
	}
	s, _, _ = strings.Cut(s, ".")
	return strings.ToLower(s)
}

func main() {
	const module = "github.com/example/app"
	sc := bufio.NewScanner(os.Stdin)
	sc.Buffer(make([]byte, 1<<20), 1<<20)
	for sc.Scan() {
		line, err := strconv.Unquote(sc.Text())
		if err != nil {
			panic(err)
		}
		flags, err := shellwords.Parse(line)
		if err != nil {
			fmt.Printf("%q\t\tERR\n", line)
			continue
		}
		fset := pflag.NewFlagSet("ldflags", pflag.ContinueOnError)
		fset.ParseErrorsAllowlist.UnknownFlags = true
		fset.SetOutput(new(strings.Builder))
		var x map[string]string
		fset.StringToStringVarP(&x, "", "X", nil, "")
		fset.BoolP("help", "h", false, "")
		if err := fset.Parse(flags); err != nil {
			fmt.Printf("%q\t\tERR\n", line)
			continue
		}
		found := make([][]string, 3)
		for key, val := range x {
			key = strings.TrimLeft(key, `'`)
			val = strings.TrimRight(val, `'`)
			if isVersionXKey(key) && isValidSemVer(val) {
				switch {
				case strings.HasPrefix(key, module+"/cmd/"):
					found[0] = append(found[0], val)
				case defaultVersionPrefixes[versionPrefix(key)]:
					found[1] = append(found[1], val)
				default:
					found[2] = append(found[2], val)
				}
			}
		}
		ver := ""
		for _, vs := range found {
			if len(vs) == 0 {
				continue
			}
			if len(vs) == 1 {
				ver = vs[0]
			}
			break
		}
		if x == nil {
			x = map[string]string{}
		}
		m, _ := json.Marshal(x)
		fmt.Printf("%q\t%s\t%s\n", line, ver, m)
	}
}
